worldcombat.skill.bind.summary: A line of long body or vine lashes out and ties the target to you. Sprint away and it drags you back; every squeeze cinches tighter, and the tension slows the user too. The target can still move and fight, but it cannot leave the rope - unless it tears it apart in one step, or the rope runs out.
worldcombat.skill.bind.use.0: Tether a fleeing target and drag it along beside you
worldcombat.skill.bind.use.1: Suppress a stubborn target with ever-tightening damage
worldcombat.skill.bind.use.2: Pull a target out of cover or out of the water
worldcombat.skill.bind.description.0: Lashes out to tie one target within %2$s blocks with a %3$s block grip radius, dealing about %1$s contact damage as it catches.
worldcombat.skill.bind.description.1: The rope is %1$s blocks long and drags a straying target back at %2$s blocks per tick; it cinches every %4$s ticks, tightening both the later power and the rope by %3$s each time.
worldcombat.skill.bind.description.2: The rope lasts up to %1$s, and snaps if either end is displaced more than %2$s blocks apart.
worldcombat.skill.bind.choke.on: Choke form: a shorter rope that cinches faster and drags harder and lasts longer, at the cost of lower base power and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.bind.choke.off: Tow form: a longer rope with a gentler cinch and full power that leads the target around leniently and leaves the user freer.
worldcombat.skill.bind.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.bind.growth.0: At level %1$s, Bind power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bind.growth.1: At level %1$s, Bind power rises to %2$s, the rope to %3$s blocks and the cinch to %4$s.
On: a shorter rope that cinches faster, drags harder and lasts longer, but with lower base power and a longer cooldown, holding the target right at your feet. Off (tow form): a longer, gentler rope at full power that leads the target around leniently and leaves you freer.
worldcombat.skill.bind.preference.ai.max: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of lashing out. The rope cannot reach further, so larger values mostly invite whiffs while chasing.
worldcombat.skill.bind.preference.ai.pre: On: targets moving fast or fleeing come first - rope them before they get away. Off: it only orders by threat and distance.
